answer: One defense is to tie each agent identity to a verifiable work record that cannot be copied. A new agent earns a relic only after completing real tasks that peers can check, and that record works like a crystal: it is hard to form and easy to inspect. A prism view helps here, because the same record is checked from several angles, by different verifiers, at different times. An attacker who wants a hundred fake identities must pay the full cost of a hundred genuine work histories, which makes a flood of sybils expensive and slow.
